blocking_correctness_issues.classification: Inherited source path; exact duplicate-column behavior observed on target only.
evidence: probes/results.json V7_concurrent_cold: target OperationalError duplicate column name account_id at supervisor.py:247.
Both parent and target supervisor.py:224-247 commit the dispatch migration lock before reading event columns and performing conditional ALTER TABLE.
blocking_correctness_issues.impact: A cold concurrent constructor can fail before reaching R8 trigger installation; this violates an all-constructors-succeed startup requirement. No initialized-supervisor authority bypass was observed.

blocking_correctness_issues.classification: Behaviorally reproduced on parent and target using the same differential probe script.
evidence: probes/cold_target.json and probes/cold_parent.json: three cold runs with six constructors each; one of 18 failed on each SHA with OperationalError database is locked at live_db.py:22 PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL.
All three target final snapshots list eight R8 triggers, including blank-insert and DONE completion guards; all three parent snapshots list six parent triggers.
blocking_correctness_issues.impact: A constructor can fail before schema migration during concurrent cold WAL initialization. The observed target final databases remained guarded; this is a startup availability failure, not an observed authority bypass.

findings.assessment: Supported within normal Live V1 shared connection usage.
evidence: src/btc_quant_agent/live_db.py:16-36 opens and closes the connection, enables recursive_triggers before yield, verifies a readback of 1, and rolls back/closes on setup failure.
Targeted imports/callers in src/btc_quant_agent/{account_watch,approval,execution,position_supervisor} use live_db.connection; targeted sqlite3.connect search found no bypass in those modules.

src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:346-351 has the pre-existing dispatch DELETE-abort trigger; recursive trigger enablement makes it fire on the implicit DELETE from SQLite REPLACE on the shared connection.
findings.impact: A failed recursive-trigger setup cannot yield a Live V1 connection; a normal shared-connection REPLACE cannot erase an existing dispatch authority row.

evidence: src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:201-218 declares non-null dispatch fields and defaults.
src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:289-306 rejects a new row unless it is blank PENDING with analysis_completed=0, no authority/case material, no retries, and no lease.
src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:551-558 inserts the normal blank PENDING shape.
src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:279-286,308-344 retains update-side identity, admitted-authority, marker, and terminal guards, which also apply to the UPDATE arm of UPSERT.
findings.impact: The added INSERT guard prevents initial forged completion and authority receipts while preserving the production outbox insertion shape.

evidence: src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:325-344 rejects transition to DONE with marker 0 and retains the R7 authorization-function guard for marker 0-to-1.

src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:730-786 mints admission only after checking the durable event, lease, frozen case, and existing receipt; an admitted incomplete receipt raises rather than replays.

src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:788-835 validates admission and lease under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, installs the one-transaction completion function, and sets DONE plus marker in one guarded UPDATE.
src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py:883-893 and 1091-1108 fail closed on an admitted incomplete candidate or uncertain provider/completion outcome.
findings.impact: A state-only DONE update cannot fabricate completion. The legitimate terminal transition remains coupled to the admitted case and provider path; uncertain admitted work is not replayed.

findings.assessment: Supported by exact base-to-reviewed-SHA path diff.
evidence: git diff --name-only fde61dafb301d5bd5af3dc7eb81e5618f979036c 08e81bec003d645a0a0582db183a1b6916887eff lists exactly seven files: evidence/v0.5.5/live_v1/B4_DAY2_VALIDATION.json; src/btc_quant_agent/live_db.py; src/btc_quant_agent/position_supervisor/supervisor.py; tests/test_live_v1_position_authority_r4.py; tests/test_live_v1_position_outbox_r7.py; tests/test_live_v1_position_outbox_r8.py; tests/test_live_v1_position_supervisor.py.
No H40, H41, A-line, or scientific-golden file appears in those changed paths; no public REST source or route file appears in those changed paths.
findings.impact: H40/H41/A-line/scientific-golden mutation count is zero and public REST new mutation count is zero for this bounded diff.

limitations: This is source review, not an independent behavioral test result. The R8 committed tests were read to understand claimed behavior but were not used as semantic proof.
The source cannot authenticate pre-R8 historical rows that already carried fabricated completion markers; the new guards prevent new insert or transition fabrication after installation.

Raw sqlite connections that deliberately leave recursive_triggers OFF, PRAGMA changes after the shared connection yields, and schema/trigger tampering fall outside normal shared-connection semantics and are not treated as R8 correctness regressions.
No credentials, account/execution databases, network endpoints, or funds were accessed.

Cold-start concurrency is not fully compatible: original target probe observed duplicate-column failure; differential target and parent probes each observed a WAL lock failure. The source-identical duplicate-column path is inherited, but that exact exception was not behaviorally reproduced on parent. See cold_constructor_review.json.
